company.description: The company name as given in the input.

studio_archetype.description: One short phrase: founder-led boutique, DP-led, agency, huge production company, or unknown.

operating_model.description: 2-3 short tags, not a sentence. e.g. ["Founder-led boutique", "Owner-operated"]. Empty array if unsupported.

studio_personality.description: 2-3 short tags describing how you'd work with them day to day. e.g. ["Independent", "Hands-on", "Relationship-driven"] or ["Structured", "Process-driven", "Scalable"]. Empty array if unsupported.

creative_dna.description: Aesthetic sensibility, NOT market or industry. Good: Minimal, Raw, Performance, Luxury, Character-driven, Adventure, Naturalistic, Lifestyle, Graphic. Bad: Outdoor, Automotive, Tech, Retail - those are markets, not creative DNA. 2-4 tags. Empty array if unsupported.

visual_dna.description: Visual style as single/double-word tags. Good: Naturalistic, Filmic, Textured, Restrained, Graphic, Clean, Elegant, Bold, Raw. Bad: full sentences describing an image. Max 5 tags. Empty array if unsupported.

decision_maker.description: Name and/or title only, short. e.g. "Founder (Mara)". UNKNOWN if unsupported.

buyer_personality.description: 2-3 short tags on how they evaluate and decide. e.g. ["Relationship-driven", "Craft-first", "Founder-led decisions"]. Empty array if unsupported.

human_angle.description: Exactly ONE concrete, specific human observation, a few words. Never a generic compliment. UNKNOWN if unsupported.

colorkaar_angle.description: A short punchy phrase, roughly 3-8 words, on why Colorkaar specifically matters here. Not a sentence that explains itself with an em-dash. Not an email.

conversation_starter.description: A specific topic to open with, a few words, not a compliment.

avoid.description: Short tags (1-3 words each) for topics/tones that would misread the room. e.g. ["Pricing", "Awards", "Volume framing"]. Not sentences.

why_this_lead.description: 3-5 short bullets synthesizing the case for outreach - the gut-check a producer reads before deciding whether to write at all. e.g. ["Founder-led", "Image-first", "No internal grading", "Relationship-driven"].

outreach_priority.description: Your proposed priority tier. Recomputed deterministically downstream from studio_archetype and confidence - reason honestly.

confidence.description: High: multiple facts stated directly. Medium: some facts stated, real inference required. Low: mostly inferred, thin evidence.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences on why you chose the human angle and Colorkaar angle, and why this confidence level. Debug only, dropped before export.
